substeps.caption: The chamber door swings open on its left-hand hinge.
An 80 mm build plate goes onto the platform.
Door shut; nitrogen from the NitroPod, made from air, fills the chamber. Drawn see-through from here.
The recoater spreads 316L powder from the sealed supply cartridge over the plate.
The fibre laser, a 40 um spot, melts the layer's cross-section.
The platform drops a layer; the recoater spreads fresh powder over it.
The platform drops a layer; the recoater spreads fresh powder over it.
660 mm tall, so it goes through the opening with 67.5 mm to spare. A Kickstarter kit: not shipping yet.
